regions.name: Fife
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops in Fife | Granite Systems, Kirkcaldy
regions.description: Granite, quartz, Dekton, marble and Corian worktops for kitchens, bathrooms and bars across Fife. Templated, made and fitted by our own team. Free quotes.
regions.local: Our workshop is on the Randolph Industrial Estate in Kirkcaldy, so wherever you are in Fife, from Dunfermline to St Andrews, we're never far away. You're welcome to come in and look through the range before you choose, and if you only need something small, ask about offcuts for hearths, tabletops and vanity tops.

regions.name: Edinburgh & the Lothians
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Edinburgh & Lothians | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke granite, quartz and Dekton worktops for Edinburgh, Midlothian, East and West Lothian. Templated on site, made and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: Edinburgh is a short run over the Queensferry Crossing. From New Town tenements and Victorian villas to new builds in West Lothian, older properties rarely have square walls, so every worktop is cut to your room rather than to a standard size.

regions.name: Dundee & Angus
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Dundee & Angus | Granite Systems
regions.description: Granite, quartz, Dekton and marble worktops for Dundee, Broughty Ferry, Arbroath and across Angus. Templated, made and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: Dundee is just over the Tay Road Bridge from north Fife. We make worktops for city flats and West End villas, family homes in Broughty Ferry and Monifieth, and farmhouses and holiday lets across rural Angus, and we're just as set up for bars, cafés and restaurants.

regions.name: Perth & Kinross
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Perth & Kinross | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke stone worktops for Perth, Kinross, Crieff, Blairgowrie and Highland Perthshire. Granite, quartz and Dekton, templated, made and fitted.
regions.local: Perth is a straight run up the M90. Across Perthshire we work on family homes, country houses and holiday lets, and with hotels on bar tops and bathroom vanities, from Kinross and Auchterarder up to Pitlochry and Aberfeldy.

regions.name: Stirling, Falkirk & Clackmannanshire
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Stirling & Falkirk | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke stone worktops for Stirling, Falkirk and Clackmannanshire. Granite, quartz and Dekton, templated, made and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: Central Scotland is just across the Kincardine and Clackmannanshire bridges. We work directly with homeowners and alongside kitchen showrooms and developers, whether that's a single vanity top in Bridge of Allan or every kitchen on a new development in Larbert.

regions.name: Glasgow & Dunbartonshire
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Glasgow | Granite Systems
regions.description: Granite, quartz, Dekton and Corian worktops for Glasgow, East and West Dunbartonshire. Templated on site, made and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: From West End tenements and Southside sandstone villas to new apartments along the Clyde and family homes in Bearsden and Milngavie, Glasgow kitchens come in every shape. A typical job is just two visits: one to template once your units are in, one to fit.

regions.name: Lanarkshire
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Lanarkshire | Granite Systems
regions.description: Stone worktops for North and South Lanarkshire: Hamilton, East Kilbride, Motherwell, Airdrie and beyond. Granite, quartz and Dekton, made and fitted.
regions.local: Lanarkshire is a straightforward run via the M80 and M74, from Cumbernauld and Airdrie down to Hamilton, East Kilbride and Lanark. Whether it's a new-build kitchen or a farmhouse in the Clyde Valley, the process is the same: one templating visit, one fitting visit.

regions.name: Renfrewshire & Inverclyde
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Paisley, Renfrewshire & Inverclyde | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke stone worktops for Paisley, Renfrewshire, East Renfrewshire and Inverclyde. Granite, quartz and Dekton, templated, made and fitted.
regions.local: We cover Paisley and Renfrewshire, East Renfrewshire and the Inverclyde coast, from family homes in Newton Mearns and Giffnock to sea-view kitchens in Gourock and Kilmacolm. Send a kitchen plan or rough sizes and we'll come back with a price.

regions.name: Ayrshire & Arran
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Ayrshire | Granite Systems
regions.description: Granite, quartz and Dekton worktops for North, East and South Ayrshire: Ayr, Troon, Kilmarnock, Irvine, Largs and Arran. Made and fitted by our own team.
regions.local: Ayrshire's coastline is full of homes and holiday lets that suit a hard-wearing surface, from Largs and Troon down to Girvan. Dekton and quartz shrug off sand, salt and heavy use, which makes them a good fit for rentals. Projects on Arran are planned around the ferry.

regions.name: Dumfries & Galloway
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Dumfries & Galloway | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke stone worktops for Dumfries, Castle Douglas, Stranraer and across Dumfries & Galloway. Granite, quartz and Dekton, templated, made and fitted.
regions.local: Dumfries & Galloway is one of our longer runs, so we book templating and fitting around your kitchen installation date and keep the visits to a minimum. From farmhouses and steading conversions to holiday cottages on the Solway coast, you get the same team and the same finish as customers on our doorstep.

regions.name: the Scottish Borders
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Scottish Borders | Granite Systems
regions.description: Stone worktops for the Scottish Borders: Galashiels, Melrose, Peebles, Kelso, Hawick and beyond. Granite, quartz and Dekton, made and fitted.
regions.local: From Peebles and the Tweed Valley to Kelso, Jedburgh and Hawick, Borders kitchens range from period townhouses to farmhouses and steading conversions with long runs and big islands. Large-format slabs mean fewer joins on long worktops.

regions.name: Aberdeen & Aberdeenshire
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Aberdeen & Aberdeenshire | Granite Systems
regions.description: Granite, quartz and Dekton worktops for Aberdeen, Westhill, Stonehaven, Inverurie, Ellon and across Aberdeenshire. Templated, made and fitted.
regions.local: The Granite City deserves a proper stone worktop. Across Aberdeen and Aberdeenshire, from Cults and Westhill to Stonehaven, Banchory and Inverurie, we work with homeowners, builders and kitchen studios, and we plan our North East visits around your installation date.

regions.name: Inverness, the Highlands & Moray
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Inverness & Highlands | Granite Systems
regions.description: Bespoke stone worktops for Inverness, the Highlands and Moray: Nairn, Aviemore, Elgin, Fort William and beyond. Granite, quartz and Dekton.
regions.local: From Inverness and the Moray coast to Aviemore and Fort William, Highland projects are often new builds, renovations and holiday lodges where durability matters as much as looks. We schedule visits around your build programme. If you're on one of the islands, just ask.

regions.name: Argyll & Bute
regions.title: Granite & Quartz Worktops Argyll & Bute | Granite Systems
regions.description: Stone worktops for Oban, Helensburgh, Dunoon, Lochgilphead and across Argyll & Bute. Granite, quartz and Dekton, templated, made and fitted.
regions.local: From Helensburgh and the Rosneath peninsula to Oban, Dunoon and Kintyre, Argyll homes, hotels and holiday lets need surfaces that cope with busy kitchens and coastal air. We plan templating and fitting around your installation date, ferries included.
